_role: Heavy / breakthrough tank (Tiger, IS-3, Maus register). Where light reads as 'sloped to deflect', heavy reads as 'thick enough not to care': slab-sided and tall, high tub_frac (~0.6) with a near-full-width upper structure (upper_w ~0.9), a thick BLUNT steep glacis rather than a thin wedge, and deep boxy sponsons. Chunky edges throughout.

primitives._note: Lower tub - tall (tub_frac ~0.6), full width, near-vertical slab sides.
Upper structure barely narrows (upper_w ~0.9) - this is what gives the slab-sided read instead of a tapered one.

Thick, steep, BLUNT frontal plate - the whole plate stays tall rather than tapering to a sharp wedge. Blunt also means a front sponson-embed muzzle exits cleanly (the least severe case of the shared front-glacis caveat).
Deep boxy left sponson over the track run.
Turret ring platform on the roof.
Commander cupola - a heavy-tank signature, kept off-centre so it doesn't eat the pintle's spot.
